title: 点赞和无限滚动：竟是设计好的伤害，谁为青少年买单？
speaker: Rob Bonta

segments.en: this week meta-platforms faces what's being called its big tobacco moment
segments.zh: 本周Meta平台面临所谓的“烟草时刻”

segments.en: one of the two dozen states are suing the social media giant accusing designers of creating an addictive app that's harming its youngest users
segments.zh: 二十多个州起诉这家社交媒体巨头，指控其设计者打造了让人上瘾的应用，伤害最年轻的用户

segments.en: any of us with kids really understand this one for states leading this first case including California where this trial will get underway
segments.zh: 有孩子的人都能理解。多个州牵头此案，包括加州，审判即将在这里开始

segments.en: and we're joined right now by one of the forces behind the suit California's attorney general Rob Bonta
segments.zh: 现在请到诉讼背后的推动者之一，加州总检察长Rob Bonta

segments.en: well has to do with the design of their products both Facebook and Instagram they design their product to be dangerous
segments.zh: 这与他们产品的设计有关，Facebook和Instagram都把产品设计得危险

segments.en: they knew that it was dangerous and they lied to the public
segments.zh: 他们知道危险，却对公众撒谎

segments.en: the design includes the algorithmic feed it includes beeps in alerts likes infinite scroll auto play ephemeral content like Instagram stories
segments.zh: 设计包括算法推送、提示音、点赞、无限滚动、自动播放、像Instagram故事这样的短暂内容

segments.en: sort of that constellation of different features that they designed created the harm
segments.zh: 这一系列功能设计造成了伤害

segments.en: they did internal research where they knew it hurt the mental health of kids it created anxiety depression body image issues
segments.zh: 他们的内部研究知道这会伤害孩子的心理健康，引发焦虑、抑郁、身体形象问题

segments.en: addictive tendencies learning loss and they double down and chose profit over the safety of children
segments.zh: 上瘾倾向、学习能力下降，但他们变本加厉，选择利润而非孩子的安全

segments.en: I'm a dad of three any parent teacher or guardian knows the detrimental impact of these products
segments.zh: 我是三个孩子的父亲，任何家长、老师或监护人都知道这些产品的危害

segments.en: and this is the tobacco moment for meta and this is time for them to be held accountable
segments.zh: 这是Meta的“烟草时刻”，是时候追究他们的责任了

segments.en: so we have picked a jury and we have opening statements and begin our trial on Tuesday
segments.zh: 我们已经选好陪审团，周二将进行开庭陈述并开始审判

segments.en: I will be there personally and we look forward to making our case bringing this case to trial and holding meta accountable
segments.zh: 我会亲自到场，期待陈述案情，将Meta绳之以法
